description:
The Pathfinder XE is a new and exciting concept to the e-bike world, inspired by the machines of the mountain bike pioneers, we have brought a retro approach to a cutting-edge platform that offers multi-terrain capability and powerful, controlled electric assistance in a package weighing just 17kg.
The Pathfinder XE with its powerful, smooth and controlled power assistance is a bicycle designed to take you further into the urban jungle and elevate you higher than ever across off-road tracks and trails. This is a bicycle equally at home cutting through traffic as it is exploring the path less travelled. The Pathfinder XE is made from the highest quality Reynolds steel and is meticulously hand-crafted in England. This is a discipline-crossing machine designed for the modern-day explorer, traversing a multitude of terrains with style and purpose.The Pathfinder XE is made from legendary Reynolds steel and meticulously hand-crafted in Britain to give you a statement machine that bridges the gap between a city hybrid and an off-road focused mountain bike.With a nod towards Pashley's legendary dirt jump and trials dominance during the late 90s the Pathfinder XE carves out a way to blend city commuting with off-road adventures, perfectly matched to weekday urban streets and weekend gravel paths or merge the two with exhilarating multi-terrain rides. Equipped with mountain bike tyres and a lightweight carbon fibre fork, enjoy a smooth, responsive ride across varied terrains, with the added benefit of a powerful, quiet and reliable electric-assist drive to make your adventures go further.
The black, anodised riser handlebars provide a comfortable, confidence-inspiring grip, ensuring you're always in control, while a sleek front carrier rack adds to the practicality of the Pathfinder XE, giving you the option to carry up to 6kg of luggage without compromising on performance or style.

components.description: Shimano MT201 Hydraulic Disc Brakes. 160mm rotors
Shimano Cues U6000 Crankset 40T with Narrow / Wide tooth profile for chain retention.
250Wh rechargeable battery integrated into the specially formed downtube of the frame.
Mahle X30 electric assist rear hub motor, 250Wh internal battery.
Full Carbon Fork, Tapered Steerer 1,1/2, 1,1/8. 12x100 Thru Axle. Pashley Porteur rack compatible
Black beadblasted Aluminium MTB style Handlebar. 31.8 diameter clamp. 30mm rise, 16 degree backsweep, 720mm width.; Black beadblast Aluminium stem (50mm) and seatpost (27.2)
Compatible with a centrally mounted ‘flip-down’ sprung propstand. (available separately)
Black platform pedals with grip tape
Front Porteur carrier fitted as standard. 6kg load capacity.
Schwalbe Smart Sam 27.5 X 2.1" MTB. Tan sidewalls
700c Aluminium Rim (23mm internal width, Tubeless ready) laced to Shimano RS470 hubs using Sapim double butted stainless spokes (28H)
